title: Sort Steps QA
eyebrow: Built and checked by hand · ready for you to test · issues #188 to #191

short.lead: The Sort screen now goes one part at a time: folder, then flags, then ties to other tasks, with a search box on each part. The slip is the paper card showing the thought or task you are sorting. The focus pick offers blockers first, starting with the task that unblocks the most. It runs on your machine at the address in step 1, with its own sample data, so your real tasks are not touched.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what to try and what you should see.
items: A test copy of the app from branch AjsAgent/sort-steps, loaded with 19 sample folders and 45 sample flags.
Open http://127.0.0.1:8765/docs/generated/sort-steps/seed.html in your browser. It loads sample data on that address only, then opens the Sort screen.

items.alt: The built Sort screen on part 1
items.caption: Part 1 in the built app.

items: The list of folders narrows as you type, and the folder you choose appears on the slip.
Type 'shed' in 'Find a folder…', choose Shed rebuild, and press 'Next: flags →'.
Find, make and stick on flags
The flags narrow as you type; '+ New flag' makes one that doesn't exist.
Type 'rep', choose Repair, then type a made-up word and press '+ New flag'. Both flags appear on the edge of the slip.

items.alt: Part 2 with the search 'rep' showing two flag cards and a New flag button
items.caption: Part 2 in the built app.

items: Tie it to other tasks, then file
Ties are saved with the task when you file it.

Press '+ Add' next to Subtasks and add a new subtask. Press '+ Add' next to Waits on and pick a task from another folder. Then press 'File it in Shed rebuild →'. Before filing, also try '+ Add notes' and editing the slip's title.

items.alt: Part 3 with a new subtask, a waits-on tie and the Holds up search
items.caption: Part 3 in the built app.

items: A pick from Shed rebuild offers the new subtask first, because it unblocks the task you filed.
On the Focus screen, draw from the Shed rebuild folder. The note should say 'Unblocks 1 task'.
Your reply moves the issues on.
Reply 'QA passed: sort steps fitted 1A', or say what's wrong.
